requirement: R12 navigation invalidates pending resyncs; failure attribution includes routeId
navigationFence: ChangedUrl now advances refresh.resyncToken, clears refresh.message and settles refresh.status='idle' in BOTH the Diagnostics and non-Diagnostics branches, while issuing the fresh diagnostics read. Any pending success/failure from before navigation carries the old token and is ignored; a success whose routeId no longer matches is ignored too (no stale state written to the new route).
failureAttribution: Message.RefreshResyncFailed and RefreshSnapshot failure now carry routeId. update applies a failure only when (a) token === refresh.resyncToken, (b) the current route is Diagnostics, and (c) current route.id === message.routeId. Otherwise the model is untouched.
tests: Round-trip /diagnostics/a -> 1->3 resync pending -> /diagnostics/b -> /diagnostics/a (fresh build-a-3), then resolve OLD payload build-A-stale last: page keeps build-a-3, no stale banner, status not stale.
Failure for route A resolves after navigating to B: B keeps its fresh data and is not marked stale.
Fresh route read after pending resync with no following gap: status leaves stale and the banner is absent.
Unit attribution: token matches but failure.routeId='a' while current route='b' -> live state/message unchanged.
